cases.condition: An Agent command validity interval exceeds the frozen 300-second maximum.
cases.stimulus: Present an otherwise well-formed signed command whose expires_at minus issued_at is greater than 300 seconds.

cases.condition: An Agent authentication envelope exceeds 16,384 canonical bytes.

cases.condition: An Agent signed payload exceeds 4,096 canonical bytes.
cases.stimulus: Send an Agent operation whose signed authenticated-command payload is 4,097 canonical bytes.

cases.condition: A previously consumed single-use Agent presentation is presented again.

cases.condition: The signed expected requesting Principal differs from the independently derived OIDC Human.

cases.condition: An Agent credential is presented without an independently authenticated Human session.
cases.stimulus: Call the Agent route with a valid signed invocation and no valid Proof Human session cookie.

cases.condition: The approving Human Principal is the activator of the exact active Environment configuration bound by the approval.

cases.condition: The approving Human Principal is the same Principal as the contributing operating Agent.
cases.stimulus: Attempt changeset.approve/v3 with approver_principal_id equal to operating_principal_id.

cases.condition: The approving Human Principal is the same Principal selected to publish the approved closure.
cases.stimulus: Resolve the exact approved closure and reject when its server-derived publisher Principal equals the authenticated approver Principal.

cases.condition: The approving Human Principal is the same Principal as the requesting Human.
cases.stimulus: Attempt changeset.approve/v3 with approver_principal_id equal to requesting_principal_id.

cases.condition: The caller-pinned expected authority head is no longer the exact current head locked for changeset.approve/v3.
cases.stimulus: Submit an approval whose expected_authority_head was valid when prepared but is stale when the authoritative transaction locks the head.

cases.condition: Any sealed ChangeSet, validation, submission, intent, ContextPack, policy, or Environment digest differs from current bound state.
cases.stimulus: Submit an approval carrying one stale digest from the complete reviewed closure.

cases.condition: The approver content.reviewer assignment is absent, revoked, or not active at the evaluated authority head.

cases.condition: An artifact catalog reference would be committed before digest, length, and exact read-after-write verification completes.

cases.condition: A content address already exists but returns bytes different from the proposed canonical artifact.

cases.condition: An immutable artifact read after write has a different digest or byte length.

cases.condition: A requested artifact digest, kind, length, or export membership differs from the committed catalog reference.
cases.stimulus: Request bytes using a substituted digest or a digest not committed to the named export.

cases.condition: Request JSON attempts to supply an actor context, Principal, role, binding, or Delegation as derived identity.
cases.stimulus: Add requesting_principal_id, actor_context, or role authority to a Human request body.

cases.condition: A request attempts to select a Workspace other than the server's single configured Workspace.
cases.stimulus: Supply a body or path Workspace identifier that differs from the configured Workspace cross-check.

cases.condition: The Environment configuration activating Human is the same Principal as the proposing Human.
cases.stimulus: Activate an Environment configuration proposal using the proposal's proposed_by_principal_id.

cases.condition: Environment configuration activation and Release creation are attempted in one authoritative transaction.
cases.stimulus: Dispatch a command that would both activate configuration and create or move a Release.

cases.condition: An Environment proposal or activation does not name the exact current predecessor version and digest.
cases.stimulus: Activate a proposal after another configuration has advanced the Environment head.

cases.condition: Server configuration enables credentialed CORS with wildcard, reflected, or null origins.
cases.stimulus: Start the server with an allowed-origin policy that is not a closed exact-origin set.

cases.condition: An unsafe cookie-authenticated request lacks the exact expected same-origin Origin value.

cases.condition: An unsafe cookie-authenticated request lacks the session-bound Proof-CSRF synchronizer value.

cases.condition: A Delegation or Agent assertion is offered as authentication for the requesting Human.

cases.condition: An artifact is requested through an export that did not commit that exact digest and kind.

cases.condition: A producer-supplied or caller-pinned authority checkpoint is treated as proof of globally latest history.

cases.condition: Independent verification lacks required caller-obtained Release or authority trust inputs.

cases.condition: An evidence.export/v2 request contains an unknown selector that asks for raw OIDC subject, token, claims, or commitment-opening disclosure.
cases.stimulus: Add a raw_identity, provider_token, subject_opening, or equivalent undeclared selector to the strict evidence-export input.

cases.condition: Evidence export construction reads authority, Release, artifact, or disclosure heads outside its committed exact snapshot.

cases.condition: An HTTP Idempotency-Key header is offered as a replacement for the normalized application idempotency field.

cases.condition: An equivalent Human retry uses the same application key and normalized input after fresh authorization.

cases.condition: A valid exact issuer-subject pair has no immutable pre-existing Human binding.

cases.condition: A Human operation name-major pair is absent or disabled in the committed closed registry.

cases.condition: State or authority used to construct candidate effect bytes changes before authoritative signing and catalog commit.

cases.condition: An untrusted evidence member path contains a parent or current-directory segment, an empty segment, a trailing separator, or a backslash alias.
cases.stimulus: Verify otherwise identical manifests using a/../../x, a/./b, a//b, a/b/, and a\b as member_path mutations.

cases.condition: A captured or external evidence member substitutes artifact kind, schema, version, media type, canonicalization, digest context, delivery mode, or disclosure identity while retaining other labels.
cases.stimulus: Mutate each frozen descriptor identity field independently and attempt to verify the original content digest or caller-supplied bytes.

cases.condition: The outer closure binding, captured root member, bundle descriptor, or exact RemoteReleaseArtifactClosureV1 bytes select a different member path or closure-manifest digest.
cases.stimulus: Substitute the direct Release-artifact closure identity or its exact manifest bytes while retaining the original outer RemoteEvidenceManifestV2 digest claim.

cases.condition: The producer-selected remote record-set base head differs from the independently supplied VerificationTrustPolicyV2 initial head or omits an intervening sequence.
cases.stimulus: Verify a validly shaped signed suffix whose base_head, first sequence, predecessor, or continuity does not extend the caller-pinned initial head exactly.

cases.condition: An independently valid accepted-artifact Release closure and P8 remote-authority closure disagree on Workspace, Release, Proof envelope, result, application effect, target decision or target consequence.
cases.stimulus: Compose two valid but unrelated closures or mutate any RemoteEvidenceClosureBindingsV1 cross-link while retaining both inner signatures.

cases.condition: A descriptor-only decision fixture or normative expected outcome is presented as an observed Complete remote-verifier execution.
cases.stimulus: Set runtime_qualified true or emit a runtime Complete report without retaining and verifying the outer manifest, direct Release-artifact closure and every selected Included artifact, every P8 remote-authority envelope, all exact attempt companions, and all closure cross-links.
